verdict.rationale: AWS documents some first-party components as open source: the AWS CDK is described as an open-source framework, and AWS publishes open-source MCP servers in its awslabs GitHub repo. Nothing in the evidence shows the core AWS cloud services' source is readable under an open license, and no specific license is named. Missing for 10: open-source availability of the core platform/services, named open licenses (e.g. Apache-2.0) for the published components, and evidence that the CLI source is openly licensed.
